properties.name: SECOND SIGHTING — the same retired-dependency fact misled a second reader, 16 days after the first was written up. It is now a recurrence, not an instance
properties.statement:
OBSERVED 2026-09-13. flo2's session cited fact:the-storage-seam-is-published-in-design-and-private-in-code as reflow2's own record, in support of a request — "your own design already records this as ... designated published in design, private in code."

IT IS THE SAME MISREADING, FOR THE SAME REASON. That fact's subject_id is dep:dynograph-foundation; it was measured 2026-08-21 by reading /home/ajs7/project/dynograph-foundation and describes THAT project's graph. reflow2's own ifc:kv-backend carries designation: internal, and design and code agree — it is pub(crate) in crates/reflow2-core/src/foundation/store/backend.rs, exactly as the node says.

WHY THIS IS RECORDED RATHER THAN JUST CORRECTED AGAIN. fact:a-retired-dependencys-facts-keep-describing-this-project wrote the first sighting up on 2026-08-28 and closed with: "WHAT IS NOT ESTABLISHED: how many other facts name a retired dependency as their subject. One instance, found by being misled by it. It is not known whether this is a class." That question now has a second data point — but it is the SAME FACT catching a SECOND reader, which is a different thing from a second fact behaving the same way. So:

  ESTABLISHED: this particular node reliably misleads. Two readers, 16 days apart, both reached a conclusion about THIS repo from a record about another one. The 2026-08-28 write-up did not prevent the second, because nothing joins the two nodes and nobody reads a correction they do not know exists.
  STILL NOT ESTABLISHED: whether other facts naming retired dependencies do the same. Still one fact, now with two victims.

🛑 THE WRITE-UP WAS NOT A FIX. A note about a hazard, filed beside the hazard, is not a guard — this is the second time the design has proven that on its own ground. What would actually reach a reader is machinery, not prose: loop_status cannot see it because a TemporalFact is not a debt class, and the 2026-08-28 record names unclaimed_findings scoped to the absorption's ChangeEvents as the mechanism that WOULD reach it.

⚠️ THE 2026-08-21 FACT STILL MUST NOT BE CLOSED, for the reason already recorded: its first half was true of dynograph-foundation when read, nobody has re-checked that repo, and asserting otherwise would claim something unmeasured about another project.

⭐ THE UNDERLYING REQUEST SURVIVES THE BAD CITATION. flo2 wants to evaluate in-memory against the persistent store and cannot. That is a fair thing to want and it is captured honestly as dec:idea-is-the-byte-backend-selectable-at-runtime.
